home.name: Suhaeb Nawab Shaik
home.tagline: Software engineering student. Building across the stack.
home.bio: I am a final-year Computer Science Engineering student at VIT-AP University, with a focus on Software Engineering. My foundation is Java, data structures, and algorithms, sharpened through regular LeetCode practice. I build full-stack applications with authenticated APIs, real-time communication, and cloud deployments, and enjoy taking a project from the first design decision through to a working release.

projects.title: Taskflow
projects.summary: Authenticated task management, from API to checkout.
projects.description:
Built task-management APIs backed by Supabase PostgreSQL schemas, with authenticated per-user access to task data.
Implemented Redis caching with time-to-live expiration and cache invalidation to support task retrieval.
Integrated Razorpay checkout with server-side HMAC-SHA256 signature verification to validate payment authenticity.

projects.title: ScrapyV1
projects.summary: Automated price tracking across e-commerce listings.
projects.description:
Built a Dockerized price-tracking application with Playwright and BeautifulSoup scraping adapters for e-commerce product data.
Implemented MongoDB price-history storage and fuzzy product comparisons to track pricing across collected listings.
Added API controls and scheduled scraping through GitHub Actions; validated functionality with 32 pytest tests and verified persistence of live scrape results.

projects.title: WatchParty
projects.summary: Live rooms, shared experiences, and browser-based streaming.
projects.description:
Developed Socket.IO rooms and real-time chat with signed guest access, room isolation, and reconnection handling.
Implemented WebRTC streaming with STUN/TURN configuration and optional Janus AudioBridge integration.
Built a Manifest V3 browser-extension overlay; added 12 unit/API tests and performed browser checks for camera access and fallback behavior.

projects.title: Dynamic Portfolio
projects.summary: An editable portfolio that updates in real time.
projects.description:
Built React, Express, and MongoDB admin CRUD with bcrypt/JWT authentication, session revocation, drag ordering, and Socket.IO updates.
Verified API behavior, real database operations, and updates across two browser sessions.
